expectations.evidence: The rewrite adds "That one change did more than anything else we tried," a ranking claim the original never makes, and also adds "spent waiting" and the "right three services instead of all eleven" conclusion.
There are no em dashes, cliches or staged reveals. "The cache got the headlines, but the benchmark is why..." and "start there" are mild, plain closers rather than stock uplift.

Wording is concrete and sentence length varies, for example "They went to downloading the same dependencies over and over." and "Three of the 11 services accounted for 70% of build time, so we started with those."
It stays a plain engineering team blog post, with section headings like "Caching" and "Test shards" and no hype, jokes or bullet-list dryness.
